1.web: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
1.asv: Wisdom hath builded her house; She hath hewn out her seven pillars:

2.web: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
2.asv: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table:

3.web: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
3.asv: She hath sent forth her maidens; She crieth upon the highest places of the city:

4.web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
4.asv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: As for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,

5.web: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
5.asv: Come, eat ye of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.

6.web: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
6.asv: Leave off, ye simple ones, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.

7.web: He who corrects a mocker invites insult. He who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
7.asv: He that correcteth a scoffer getteth to himself reviling; And he that reproveth a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

8.web: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise man, and he will love you.
8.asv: Reprove not a scoffer, lest he hate thee: Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.

9.web: Instruct a wise man, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
9.asv: Giveinstructionto a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.

10.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
10.asv: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

11.web: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
11.asv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.

12.web: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
12.asv: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scoffest, thou alone shalt bear it.

13.web: The foolish woman is loud, Undisciplined, and knows nothing.
13.asv: The foolish woman is clamorous; She is simple, and knoweth nothing.

14.web: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
14.asv: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,

15.web: To call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
15.asv: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:

16.web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
16.asv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither; And as for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,

17.web: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
17.asv: Stolen waters are sweet, And breadeatenin secret is pleasant.

18.web: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
18.asv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
